Government-subsidized units (e.g., Housing Choice Voucher/Section 8, Shelter Plus Care, VASH, LIHTC, HOME) are fully or partially covered depending on unit type and whether Federal law, State law or regulation prohibits rent control. Utility charges for fully covered units must be included in base rent unless the utility is separately metered and the lease requires the tenant to hold the account.",

Units where the tenant shares a kitchen or bath with the landlord are exempt only if the landlord lived on the same property at the start of the tenancy. 'Golden Duplex' units (owner-occupied on Dec 31, 1979, with an owner currently living in one unit) are exempt.
